e5_L9.H5_verdict: reversed: R1 is markedly LESS hubby than R2
e5_L9.note: The rule ranks by hubness among representations not worse on in-context self-hit. R1 is excluded because its in-context self-hit is ~7 points below R2/R3 -- but note that self-hit against R2/R3 is structurally favoured (a prototype is an average of token states of the same word), so Pilot C evaluates R1, R2 and R3 end to end and lets retrieval arbitrate.
